title: Slightly less than two drinks (cut from That Mitchell and Webb Look S04E04)
summary: A six-minute sketch from That Mitchell and Webb Look in which a speaker argues you should never drink more than slightly less than two drinks, the mildly intoxicated sweet spot before drunken madness.
why: HN uses it as a joke reference in threads about alcohol, cannabis and the Ballmer Peak, not as a recommendation.

quote.text: There's this great sketch about being slightly drunk
